definitions.gloss: objective viewpoint; viewing something objectively; seeing from a detached perspective
definitions.explanation: The act of looking at something — especially oneself or one's own situation — from an impartial, detached standpoint rather than a subjective or emotional one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to view the situation objectively and make calm judgments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{時|とき}⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦{感情的|かんじょうてき}→感情的：05678_kanjouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なら→なる：01970_naru⟧ず、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: It is precisely when you fail that viewing your own actions objectively — rather than getting emotional — leads to growth.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{客観|きゃっかん}→客観：24382_kyakkan⟧ (objectivity) and {視|し} (viewing/seeing). Functions as a suru-verb: {客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to view objectively."

This word is commonly used in self-improvement, business, psychology, and counseling contexts. The ability to ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (see oneself objectively) is considered an important skill in Japanese professional culture, often discussed in job interviews and performance reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to view oneself objectively
- ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to view the situation objectively
- {客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to see objectively
- {客観視|きゃっかんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: difficult to view objectively

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{客観的|きゃっかんてき}→客観的：05696_kyakkanteki⟧: objective (adjective)
- ⟦{俯瞰|ふかん}→俯瞰：09330_fukan⟧: bird's-eye view (looking at the big picture)
- ⟦{主観|しゅかん}→主観：11466_shukan⟧: subjectivity (the opposite perspective)
